sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The lock stopped at (51,37) — it's on the bottom line, but hasn't reached the bottom end (51,55). I pressed RIGHT 7 times, but the lock only advanced from (51,13) to (51,37) = 24 columns = 4 steps. So 3 of the RIGHT presses didn't work? Wait: LEFT×3, DOWN×3 worked (13,51). Then RIGHT×7: only 4 worked (13→37). Hmm, maybe the lock can't enter the bottom board region? The bottom board is at columns 42-55, rows 44-57. The lock at (51,37) is right to the left of the bottom board. The track continues to (51,55) (the bottom end, the right side of the bottom board). But the lock stopped at 37.
Maybe the lock can't pass through / enter the bottom board — the bottom board is blocking the track! So the bottom end (51,55) is unreachable... or the lock can only reach the bottom end when the bottom board is "solved" / cleared?
Wait, actually looking at the image: the lock is at (51,37), right next to the left edge of the bottom board (column 42). The bottom line of the track continues behind the bottom board to the right edge. The bottom board is sitting on top of the track!
So the goal is: the lock needs to reach the bottom end, but the bottom board is blocking it. How to clear the bottom board? The bottom board has 1 dot at (51,43). If I merge / move that dot... to where? There's only 1 dot.
Or, the bottom board disappears when its dot is "collected" by the lock? The lock is adjacent to the bottom board. Hmm.
Or, the bottom dot needs to be moved to the right cell (51,49), making the left cell empty, and then... no, that's not it.
Wait — maybe the bottom board is a "door": the lock passes through when the bottom board is solved (1 dot = already solved?). Hmm.
Let me try pressing RIGHT once more to see if it moves.
